description: The chart illustrates the distribution of three categories - Context, Generated Response, and Other - across two groups, "Ours" and "Standard". The vertical axis, labeled with the group names, contains the categories, while the horizontal axis represents the percentage values, ranging from 0% to 100% with no explicit tick labels but implied equal intervals. Each group is represented by a stacked bar, comprising three segments colored blue (Context), orange (Generated Response), and green (Other). For "Ours", the blue segment is approximately 60.6% long, the orange segment is about 31.7% long, and the green segment is around 7.7% long. For "Standard", the blue segment is roughly 23.6% long, the orange segment is approximately 51.1% long, and the green segment is about 25.3% long. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart effectively compares the proportional distribution of the three categories between the "Ours" and "Standard" groups.
